title: Shinonome Ena — The Animal From My Memory〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas

rows.Line: Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ena! Honami!
Thank you both for coming over to my house again!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you for letting us use your house to do sketches together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's nice to see you again too, Honami. We haven't met since your shadowing, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I've been looking forward to receiving another lesson from you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, I really appreciate that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now, I'm gonna have you do some sketches today, but let's make having fun a priority.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Your first subject will be...
These.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, so many apples! They look so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. A standard in terms of subjects.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right? Now, before we start, let's take a closer look at them by actually picking them up and seeing how they look and feel.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How they look and feel?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it's important to have a clear understanding of what you're sketching. That includes getting a good idea of your subject's form, texture and even how much it weighs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At the same time, I don't want you to think too hard about it initially. For now, let's just get a feel for their texture and get a sense of how much they weigh.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... It weighs... As much as any other apple...? Oh, this one's bigger on the right side towards the bottom and even feels a bit bumpy...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, good catch.
That's exactly what I was talking about just now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Knowing about these sorts of imperfections can greatly affect how your sketch looks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Emu, you should also try picking one up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Then, I'll choose... This one!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They both did a really good job of picking out the unique features of their respective apples.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honami got a good grasp of her apple's form, while Emu focused on the color of the skin and how smooth the texture is.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (All that's left for them is to turn their observations into art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But that's actually easier said than done. I mean, it's pretty normal for Mr. Yukihira to say how awful my sketches are...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Anyway, let's see how they're doing...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm? This part is indented a little...
Wait, if I try to include that, the rest of my sketch will look funny...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honami seems to be having trouble with its form. I'm guessing she's trying to include all the different features that she noticed after holding it.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (As for Emu...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... I wanna make it nice and shiny, but it just keeps getting blacker and blacker...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(She's trying to get the texture right.
Yeah, it really isn't easy. I still struggle with that...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (As much as they're struggling, they're incredibly focused.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I didn't realize they'd take to this so well. I'm glad that I suggested we do this.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Ena, I'm having some trouble with this... Would you mind giving me some advice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I want some advice too!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, just gimme a second.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, let's pause here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, we've been drawing for quite a while now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You both did a good job of inspecting your apples and staying focused while you drew them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, Emu, let's start with your sketch.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Here's my apple!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow...! Emu, your apple looks delicious! And it's so shiny!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. My goal was to make it look really crisp and yummy♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I drew mine while thinking a lot about how it would taste when somebody at it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
Considering it's your first sketch, you did a great job with the skin's texture!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well done, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're next, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Here's mine...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Overall, I think you captured its form pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: R-Really? I did?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I tried to draw what I felt when I held it in my hand. But the more I drew, the less it became what I imagined...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, compared to Emu, I didn't do nearly as good a job when it comes to capturing its texture...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but I really do think you did a good job with its form. The stem portion in particular.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right!
You did way better than me when it comes to that, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, you really did do a good job, Honami, so nice work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, it's getting pretty late, so let's call things here and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe... My tummy's growling... I guess it didn't help that I thought about how my apple would taste while I drew it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why don't we eat these apples?

rows.Speaker: Honami & Emu
rows.Line: What?!
